title: Page 139
transc:
McCaine Line kind  Wash'n July 30th 1864 11 AM
Grapes July Lamp For Mutton unity It is wicked
that the Ridge entered Chambers burg this morning at
Alice in Pebble Columns Pekin If so it is
to be presumed that your whisky have marched by
Waspy Tankard or whack Emmitts burg zebra It is
absolutely Tartar that I should know where they are
in order to send Webbs Inland get quick answer


Beckwith City Point 1 am
From Harrisburg Mark Ogden Rosetta to Beach happy tulip
Just hear from Lafitte yard he has reproached Java 
and Mack Causland out of Chambers burg & is
romancing thine Walker Wheedle Eagle yacht the best part
of Chambers burg is in ashes Benton Sprague people
thought to be house less yard Samples state that
a raid is being made by Ingrate wheedle Wheeling
or above to return via Aragon Valley tulip this
seems to confirm a previous opinion of Lafitte of
a raid in that direction yard Samples say that 
Kettles Pelham is to web hang tulip Early to
hold the valley while ingrate makes his raid yacht
I will notify Africa and Pittsbg stick I presume
Lafitte wishes copy of this sent to Meriden Lobster
